description: Authorizes an agent to place one order through a vendor run agent gateway (Walmart's, in this example). Every order needs a signed approval for that cart, covering its maximum total. Orders with a maximum total above 500 are refused. The connector endpoint refuses to place the order if the vendor's quoted total is above the approved maximum.

outcome.reason: Order refused because the maximum total must be greater than 0.
Order refused because its maximum total is above 500.
Order approved by a trusted person for this cart, up to this maximum total.
An order needs a signed approval for this cart covering its maximum total, in signals.approvalArtifact, with orderApproved true.
